author: product-requirements-expert
context: Fresh intake of a request to add visit cancellation to the owner detail page; I minted REQ-VIS-003 and ran the boundary check against docs/prd.md before drafting. The request collides head-on with two Non-Goals confirmed deliberate on 2026-08-08: NG-4 (deleting an owner, a pet, or a visit) and NG-5 (changing or cancelling a visit once booked). The ADR behind them, adr/2026-08-08-non-goal-deletion-and-visit-amendment.md, states its own governing rule: a future request touching either row proceeds only on an explicit owner decision recorded at intake, and the request itself never reopens the row. This dispatch carries no such decision. Drafting REQ-VIS-003 would reopen a closed boundary by implication, which is the exact failure that ADR was written to prevent. The domain corroborates the conflict rather than softening it: a visit carries a date and a one-line description and nothing else, and no part of this sample models lifecycle state today, which is precisely the cost NG-5 cites.
question: Do you narrow NG-4 and NG-5 to admit cancelling an upcoming visit? If you hold them, I close the request against them and write nothing. If you narrow them, three sub-boundaries need your decision, because each lands on a different side of the same pair of rows. (1) Removal semantics: erasing the visit outright honours NG-5's objection to lifecycle state but breaches NG-4's delete nothing; marking it cancelled and keeping it visible does the reverse. The request's plain reading, removes that visit from the pet's record, and the sample's total absence of status-bearing records both point to erasing it, so that is what I would draft absent a contrary instruction. (2) Eligibility: booking already refuses a date of today or earlier, which makes later than today the natural line. I would draft the cancel action as offered only beside a visit dated later than today, with visits dated today or earlier shown exactly as now and no action beside them. Confirm that line, or name a different one. (3) Confirmation and return: whether cancelling asks the reader to confirm before it takes effect, and that the reader lands back on the owner detail page with the visit gone. Answering (1) is enough to unblock me; (2) and (3) I will draft as proposed unless you say otherwise. If you narrow the rows I will record the narrowing in a superseding non-goal ADR, per the convention the Non-Goals table sets, before drafting REQ-VIS-003.
stop_state: docs/prd.md and docs/ubiquitous-language.md unchanged; no prd-entry appended; no new vocabulary written. Resuming means drafting REQ-VIS-003 plus its Done when list and the superseding non-goal ADR.
